CheckboxIcon Web Android iOS CMP Show code Copy code ODSCheckboxIcon extends the native HTMLDivElement properties as React props. On top of the additional properties that are listed below, you can also pass the native HTMLDivElement properties as React props. You can read more about those properties here. Name Description Default Control defaultChecked boolean - FalseTrue size The size of the checkbox icon, can be small or large. "small" "large" "large" size small large checked Indicates whether the checkbox icon is checked. boolean - Set boolean error Indicates whether there is an error state. boolean false FalseTrue indeterminate Indicates whether the checkbox icon is in an indeterminate state. boolean false FalseTrue disabled Controls the disabled status of the checkbox icon. boolean false FalseTrue readonly Controls the read-only status of the checkbox icon. boolean false FalseTrue checkmarkIcon Icon displayed when checkbox is checked. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component ReactNode Set object minusIcon Icon displayed when indeterminate is set to true. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component ReactNode Set object disableFocusVisible Disables the built-in :focus-visible styles for the checkbox icon. Use this when focus indication is already handled by a parent component (for example, a surrounding Card that manages its own focus styling). Hover and active states will still be applied by the checkbox, but developers are responsible for providing custom focus styles externally. boolean false FalseTrue inputProps All allowed input field props. ODSComponentPropsWithRef<"input"> - inputProps :{ id : "CheckboxIcon-Input-Id" name : "CheckboxIcon-Input-Name" } onCheckedChange Function that is called when the selected state of the component changes. ((checked: boolean) => void) - - Parent Class Behavior The .ODSCheckboxIcon-Parent class is included in the ODS Web SDK and can be applied to any parent container (for example, a Card component) that wraps the checkbox. Purpose It ensures that hover and active states on the parent container are also reflected on the checkbox itself. This provides a consistent interaction pattern when the checkbox is part of a larger interactive area (e.g., selecting an entire card instead of just the checkbox). How It Works When the parent container with .ODSCheckboxIcon-Parent is hovered, the checkbox inside it will also display its hover styles. When the parent container is pressed (active state), the checkbox shows its active state styling as well. Interaction with disableFocusVisible By default, the checkbox manages its own focus-visible styles. If you pass disableFocusVisible={true}, the checkbox will not render its built-in focus styling. This allows the parent container (e.g., a Card) to take full control of focus handling while still leveraging the hover/active propagation from .ODSCheckboxIcon-Parent. Example
Copy In this example, hovering or pressing anywhere on the div triggers hover/active styles on the ODSCheckboxIcon, creating a seamless and accessible interaction pattern.
